sn47.44:1.2: This is my instruction to you.
sn47.44:1.3: And how is a bhikkhu aware?
sn47.44:1.4: It’s when a bhikkhu meditates by observing an aspect of the body—ardently aware and comprehending, without craving and aversion towards the world
sn47.44:1.5: They meditate observing an aspect of feelings …
sn47.44:1.7: principles—ardently aware and comprehending, without craving and aversion towards the world
sn47.44:1.8: That’s how a bhikkhu is aware.
sn47.44:1.10: This is my instruction to you.”
